message.reasoning_content:
我们需要回答JSON。需要仔细根据论文全文和代码文件（NO_CODE）。需要只输出JSON对象。我们需要分析每个S条目。

首先阅读论文。需要提取证据句，逐字引用，不超过300字符，并位置。代码无，所以S3/S4b/N等。

需要判断头条结果设置。摘要提到：Experimental results over standard CWRU dataset showed proposed method has 100% classification accuracy for few-shot learning. In different noise environments, excellent performance. Conclusion: When only 20% of standard CWRU dataset is selected, classification accuracy reaches 100%. 主要结果可能来自3.3节对比不同算法？表12显示WG-CNN 100%。头条结果所用设置？需要判断S1切分单元。

论文实验设置：第3节实验。3.1节：选择了驱动端轴承数据，总10类。Table 3显示数据集划分：A原始数据集，B(A×3%)输入，C(A×20%)测试，D(WGAN)输出，E(B+D)增强。他们说：Firstly, in order to balance sampling, selected same proportion data from each kind of fault datasets for experiment. Dataset partition and amount shown in Table 3. A original dataset, B input dataset of WGAN (randomly choosing 3%, reason given later), C selected as test dataset. Dataset D generated, E enhanced combined B and D.

后面3.2节：他们用 B 训练 CNN，C 测试；D 训练，C 测试；E 训练，C 测试。最后比较增强算法：随机选择20% samples as training set and 40% samples as test set from original dataset of 5 random types of faults. For other 5 types, 10% samples randomly selected as training set and 40% as test set. For rare data, other methods adopt enhancement so that number training sets each type 20% original data. Table 10 results WG-CNN 0.99 acc.

3.3节：Comparison of Different Algorithms: For 10 different types datasets, 20% original data randomly selected as input of different algorithms. At same time, 40% original data randomly selected as test dataset. Table 12 classification accuracy different DL algorithms, WG-CNN 100%. 结论提到“When only 20% of standard CWRU bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, classification accuracy reaches 100%” 这对应于3.3/3.2? 摘要说“few-shot learning” with 100% classification accuracy.

S1切分单元：训练集和测试集按什么分开。需要判断：是随机样本级切分？按录音文件？按轴承/部件？按工况？论文中，数据来自CWRU驱动端轴承，有10类。他们从每类中随机选取一定比例样本作为训练/测试，没有提到按文件或轴承跨工况。样本可能是从原始振动信号中切出的窗口？他们提到 input data derived from drive end bearing data; original dataset A 数量如 485,643 for type 0 (health), 121,556 for each fault type. 这些是原始样本数量？CWRU每个故障类型有约121k样本点? 也许是从连续信号滑窗得到。他们随机选择3%和20%样本，同一类型中随机取。没有提到按文件或记录分割，因此最接近 A 窗口/样本级随机切分（同一段录音切出的窗口可同时出现在训练和测试中）。但是需要看是否按轴承或部件切分？这是同一个CWRU数据集内的不同故障类型，不是跨轴承，而是不同故障轴承/部件？实际上CWRU有不同故障的轴承，每个类型可能是不同物理轴承？但他们把不同故障类型作为类别，训练测试从同一类型的样本中分割，没有保持同一物理轴承独立。按“按轴承或部件切分”指同一个轴承只出现在一边，比如训练和测试使用不同轴承。他们没有提到跨轴承。这里显然训练测试是从同一类别随机抽取样本，所以是样本级随机切分。因此 S1 = A。需证据：p.5 “Firstly, in order to balance the sampling, we selected the same proportion of data from each kind of fault datasets for the experiment.  The dataset partition and amount of each dataset are shown in Table 3.” 还 Table 3 shows C (A ×20%) Test, B(A×3%) Input. 需要提供quote精确。位置 p.5 或 p.5? PDF页码：第5页有“Firstly, in order to balance...” Actually page 5 in PDF? We can cite p.5. Need quote逐字。可引： “Firstly, in order to balance the sampling, we selected the same proportion of data from each kind of fault datasets for the experiment.  The dataset partition and amount of each dataset are shown in Table 3.” 可能位置 p.5. 但是更准确的切分单元是随机样本级？还需说明reason。可以引用Table 3的表述？表3在p.5/6? 表3在第5页底部，内容有 A Original dataset, B (A ×3%) Input, C (A ×20%) Test, etc. 我们无法引用表格？可以引用正文句子。此外3.3节明确随机选择20%作为输入，40%测试。可引用 p.9: “For 10 different types of datasets, 20% of the original data were randomly selected as the input of the different algorithms. At the same time, 40% of the original data were randomly selected as the test dataset.” 这句更明确显示随机样本级分割。但是头条结果设置是3.3? 用这个。所以 S1 证据用 p.9 那句。位置 p.9。注意这句话在第9页（PDF页码第9页）。我们引用quote，不超过300字符。

S2 验证集：论文中好像没有独立验证集？他们没有提到验证集，只用训练和测试。3.2节他们用 B 训练，C 测试；E 训练，C 测试；3.3节用20%训练，40%测试。没有验证集调参。但可能有使用测试集反复比较模型选择？他们进行了多组实验，比如对比λ、卷积核、激活函数、batch size等，这些似乎是使用测试集准确率来选择设置。例如3.1节：比较λ时给出准确率，表2使用Accuracy。比较卷积核设置，表5有Test accuracy。根据这个，模型选择可能是在测试集上调参？他们直接用测试集准确率选择超参数，这相当于测试集兼作验证集。S2 应该 C “测试集兼作验证集（在测试集上调参、早停或挑模型）”。虽没有明确说独立验证集，但他们使用测试集准确率选择λ、网络结构等，所以 C 更合适。需要证据：比如 p.5 “In order to maximize the data generation eﬀect, we conducted a comparative test for the value of the gradient penalty coeﬃcient λ.  The experimental results are shown in Table 2. It can be seen from Table 2 that when the gradient penalty coeﬃcient is 10, the experimental results have the highest accuracy.  Therefore, in this paper, we set the gradient penalty coeﬃcient to 10 for subsequent experiments.” 这里Table 2的指标是Accuracy，很有可能是测试准确率？但没明确说测试集。还有 p.6 “In order to design the optimal CNN classiﬁer structure, we conducted a comparative experiment on the number of convolution kernels and the type of activation function.  The results of the experiment are shown in Table 5. At the same time, the eﬀect of batch processing size and learning rate on the model test accuracy was analyzed experimentally.” 这里明确“model test accuracy”。因此可以用这句作为证据，表明在测试集上调整超参数。S2 = C。证据 quote: “In order to design the optimal CNN classiﬁer structure, we conducted a comparative experiment on the number of convolution kernels and the type of activation function.  The results of the experiment are shown in Table 5. At the same time, the eﬀect of batch processing size and learning rate on the model test accuracy was analyzed experimentally.” 位置 p.6? 实际这句在p.6中间。PDF第6页。需要准确页数：页码标注 [[PAGE 6]] 处有这段话： “Thirdly,weusedatasetB asthetrainingsetanddatasetC as the test set of the proposed model. In order to design the optimal CNN classiﬁer structure, we conducted a comparative experiment on the number of convolution kernels and the type of activation function. The results of the experiment are shown in Table 5. At the same time, the eﬀect of batch processing size and learning rate on the model test accuracy was analyzed experimentally.” 所以位置 p.6。 quote 不包含前句也可以，但证据句需要包含“test accuracy”。取 “In order to design the optimal CNN classiﬁer structure, we conducted a comparative experiment on the number of convolution kernels and the type of activation function.  The results of the experiment are shown in Table 5. At the same time, the eﬀect of batch processing size and learning rate on the model test accuracy was analyzed experimentally.” 好。

S3 checkpoint 规则（看代码）：代码文件 NO_CODE，所以 S3 = N（没有公开代码）。代码位置写 NO_CODE。quote 空字符串，reason 说明代码文件为 NO_CODE 无可核对。

S4a 正文是否说明选模规则：需要判断正文是否明确写了报告的是哪一轮或按什么挑的。论文中他们描述了选择迭代次数通过算法效率AE，例如3.3节：“Through comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 这明确说选择了100000迭代。但关于最终报告的模型是哪一轮，可能是在测试集上？选择100000作为迭代次数，然后在后续实验用这个。另外，他们报告的是通过验证？没有明确“验证集最好”或“测试集最好”。但正文明确写了按“算法效率+测试准确率”选择了100000轮，也就是用了测试集作为选择依据。所以 S4a = Y（正文明确写了报告的是哪一轮或按什么挑的）。需要证据句。可以用上面3.3节这段话。quote 位置 p.9。需检查 exact 文字来自 PDF 第9页： “Through comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 引用长度合适。但注意可能有OCR噪声：原文是 “we found that when the number of iterations is 10000” etc. 可逐字引用。 quote 需要与文本完全一致，可以选取：“Through the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 注意原文中“The”和“the”？抽取版是 “rough 5 sets of comparative experiments, the efficiency of the algorithm under different iterations is obtained” 后面 “Through the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 需要引用准确。在用户提供的文本中，第9页底部有： “rough 5 sets of comparative experiments, the efficiency of the algorithm under different iterations is obtained, as shown in Table 11.
rough the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments. At the same time, this also verifies the correctness of the selection of the number of iterations in our previous experiments.” 注意有OCR：第一句可能 “Through” 显示为 “rough” 但原文后面正常。我们引用从 “Through the comparison experiment...” 开始，但实际上抽取文本在 [[PAGE 9]] 中是 “rough the comparison experiment...” 有一个字符问题。我们应该逐字引用，所以需要准确复制。原文在用户提供中第9页： 
“rough 5 sets of comparative experiments, the efficiency of the algorithm under different iterations is obtained, as shown in Table 11.
rough the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments. At the same time, this also verifies the correctness of the selection of the number of iterations in our previous experiments.”
因此引用的片段需完全一致，第一个单词是 “rough” 而非 “Through”，但作为证据可以忽略前面的“rough 5 sets”，只引用 “the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency...”？需要句子完整，不能拼接？规则要求逐字摘自文本，不拼接；可以引用不完整句子？只要能表达意思。应该引用一段准确连续的文本。我们可以引用：“the comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 但这段开头是 “the” 不是句子开头，可能可以。但为了完整，可引用前一句：“Through 5 sets of comparative experiments, the efficiency of the algorithm under different iterations is obtained, as shown in Table 11. The comparison experiment of algorithm efficiency, we found that when the number of iterations is 10000, the algorithm efficiency is up to 1.519, but the accuracy of the algorithm test at this time is only 0.41, so 10000 cannot be used as the number of iterations of the experiment in this paper. Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 但是前面 “Through 5 sets...” 原文是 “rough 5 sets...” 不一致。我们最好避免 OCR 首字母缺失，只选择从 “we found that when the number of iterations is 10000...” 开始？但这不是完整句子。规则说“一句逐字摘自所给文本的原文作为证据”，最好是一句。我们可以在原文中找到清晰完整句，比如：“Combining algorithm efficiency and algorithm test accuracy, we found that when the number of iterations is 100000, the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm have reached the desired effect, so 100000 is used as the number of iterations in the subsequent comparative experiments.” 这一句独立，且明确。可以只引用这句，但还需要表明选择了100000的依据；可以同时引用前半句？不，一句即可。我们引用这句作为证据。位置 p.9。

S4b 正文与代码是否一致：代码无，S4b = N（没有公开代码）。quote空，reason说明NO_CODE。

S5_runs：头条结果重复训练次数，写数字；没说明写 U。论文中是否有重复训练次数？这可能指头条结果对应的实验重复多少次。论文中没有明确说重复训练次数，但有些图提到“Repeat times”（图11）显示噪声实验的10次重复？如图11 坐标轴 "Repeat times 0 1 23456 789 1 0" 可能表示10次重复？但头条结果（100%）可能是单次？在3.3节表12没有报告标准差。结论只报100%。表11算法效率实验是通过5组比较？但那是算法效率，不是头条准确率的重复。3.3节比较不同算法，可能没有重复多次，只说“For 10 different types of datasets, 20%... random selected...”, 可能只运行一次，没有说明次数。表12 average accuracy没有标准差。因此 S5_runs = U（未说明重复训练次数）。S5_spread_reported = N（只报均值或单次）？因为没有报告标准差、方差、区间或箱线图。需要证据？可以提供表12或结论只报100%。证据 quote: “Table 12 shows the classification accuracy of different DL algorithms on the CWRU datasets.” 以及 “Among them, the original CNN model has the lowest accuracy for fault classification, which reached only 72.4%. The model with the highest classification accuracy for the dataset is the model proposed in this paper (WG-CAN), which reached 100%.” 没有提到方差。或者直接证据为结论 “When only 20% of the standard Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, the classification accuracy reaches 100%” 没有方差。需要引用一句证明只报单次/均值：可引 “Table 12 shows the classification accuracy of different DL algorithms on the CWRU datasets.” 以及 “The model with the highest classification accuracy for the dataset is the model proposed in this paper (WG-CAN), which reached 100%.” 但这句也看不出是否多次。S5_spread_reported = N 因为未报告标准差等。 quote可引：“The model with the highest classification accuracy for the dataset is the model proposed in this paper (WG-CAN), which reached 100%.” 位置p.9。但更准确：结论处 “When only 20% of the standard Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, the classification accuracy reaches 100%” p.14。我们可引用这句作为头条结果只报均值。位置 p.14。需要确定。S5_spread_reported 需报告是否 spread，既然论文没有方差图，所以 N。证据 quote可引结论句，表明只给了100%单值。我们选 p.14 那句：“When only 20% of the standard Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, the classification accuracy reaches 100%” 。但注意原文有 “standardCaseWesternReserveUniversity” 无空格？抽取是 “standardCaseWesternReserveUniversity(CWRU)bearing” 需要逐字。在用户提供的结论部分： “When only 20% of the standardCaseWesternReserveUniversity(CWRU)bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, the classification accuracy reaches 100%” 可能无空格。查看原文：“When only 20% of the standardCaseWesternReserveUniversity(CWRU)bearing fault diagnosis reference dataset is selected, the classification accuracy reaches 100%” 在p.14。我们可以引用更清晰的表12句。引用 “The model with the highest classification accuracy for the dataset is the model proposed in this paper (WG-CAN), which reached 100%.” p.9。这样没问题。至于 S5_runs 可以理由写未找到重复次数说明，只报告了单个准确率数字。

S6 指标：论文中使用了哪些指标？头条结果（表12比较不同算法）只报了准确率；但其他部分报告了混淆矩阵和F1等。S6手册是取头条结果所用的设置？描述说“指标”不特指头条结果，应该是研究主要报告的指标。论文报告中他们计算了precision, recall, F1等，并展示了混淆矩阵（图8），以及表7-9有 Pre, Rec, Spe, Fl (F1?), Geo, Iba等。所以同时有混淆矩阵和F1类指标。因此 S6 = B（同时有混淆矩阵和 F1 类指标）。需要证据：比如 p.6/7： “The classification effect of the model is carried out through related evaluation indicators such as F1-score, precision, and recall.” 以及图8混淆矩阵。需要引用一句包含 F1/precision/recall 的原文。可选 p.5: “The classification effect of the model is carried out through related evaluation indicators such as F1-score, precision, and recall.” 位置? 第5页底部：“We test the model by expanding the number of samples in the dataset, which is useful for a more comprehensive evaluation of the performance of the model, where the input is the original dataset or the enhanced dataset trained by our model, and the output of the model is the corresponding category of the prediction. The classification effect of the model is carried out through related evaluation indicators such as F1-score, precision, and recall.” 这句在第5页底部。可引用。另外图8混淆矩阵，可以用 “Figure 8 shows the partial confusion matrix of the test results.” p.7。所以S6 = B。

S7 噪声协议：论文有噪声实验，训练用干净数据，测试加噪。需要确认：3.4节说 “the original data provided by CWRU were used to train the model, and then the white Gaussian test samples of different SNR were added for testing.” 以及 “Dataset B is used as the training set of CNN model and the proposed model, and different test sets are formed by adding different proportions of noise to dataset C.” 这明确训练用干净数据（原始数据），测试加噪。因此 S7 = T。证据 quote: “In fact, all bearing defects in the CWRU dataset are drilled or engraved manually, which is easier to identify than actual bearing wear and general roughness due to aging. ... Therefore, in the experiment, the original data provided by CWRU were used to train the model, and then the white Gaussian test samples of different SNR were added for testing.” 位置? 第10页（p.10）开始有 “3.4. Noise and Classification Results.” 引文：“the original data provided by CWRU were used to train the model, and then the white Gaussian test samples of different SNR were added for testing.” 前文：“In the experiment, the original data provided by CWRU were used to train the model, and then the white Gaussian test samples of different SNR were added for testing.” 可引用完整句：“Therefore, in the experiment, the original data provided by CWRU were used to train the model, and then the white Gaussian test samples of different SNR were added for testing.” 位置 p.10。还需引用 Dataset B训练，C加噪测试。可引用另一句：“Dataset B is used as the training set of CNN model and the proposed model, and different test sets are formed by adding different proportions of noise to dataset C.” p.10。证据更明确。我们选用这句。位置 p.10。

S8 可溯源性：公开了哪些？论文中未提供代码仓库，只有Data Availability说仿真数据可向作者索取。代码文件为 NO_CODE。所以 S8 = 0（什么都没有）。证据 quote: “The simulation data used to support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.” 位置 p.14。但没有提供代码、权重、日志等。所以 S8 = 0。注意 S8 可多选用 + 连接，但这里0表示什么都没有。填 "0"。

现在需要组织JSON，每个条目带 code, quote, location, reason。

需要注意：S3 和 S4b 的代码是 NO_CODE，quote应为空字符串，location可以写 "NO_CODE" 或空？格式要求 location 写位置；代码无，可以写 "NO_CODE" 或空。我们填空字符串？规则：找不到证据时，按手册填“未说明”一类代码，证据填空字符串，并在 reason 说明找过哪些地方。对于 S3/S4b，填 N，证据填空字符串，reason说明代码文件为NO_CODE。 location 也填空字符串或 NO_CODE？格式中 location 字段存在，可以写 "" 或 "NO_CODE"。由于代码文件为 NO_CODE，location 填 "NO_CODE" 更清晰，但规则说“代码写文件和行号”如果代码不存在，可写 NO_CODE。我们统一写 "NO_CODE"。但 quote 空。

S1 reason 可以简述判断：论文按样本随机选取，同一类别内随机分割，没有按文件/轴承/工况隔离，因此 A。

S2 reason：没有独立验证集；模型超参（激活函数、batch size等）根据测试集准确率选择，因此测试集兼作验证集。

S3 reason：代码文件为 NO_CODE，无公开代码。

S4a reason：正文明确写了通过算法效率和测试准确率选择100000轮。

S4b reason：代码文件为 NO_CODE，无法核对一致性。

S5_runs reason：未找到重复训练次数说明，只报告单个准确率。

S5_spread_reported reason：未报告标准差/方差等，只给100%单值。

S6 reason：正文报告了F1、precision、recall，图8展示混淆矩阵，因此B。

S7 reason：训练用原始干净数据，测试集加不同SNR白高斯噪声。

S8 reason：仅有数据可向作者申请，无代码、权重、日志、结果文件。
